questions.question: What distinguishes a Copilot agent from a general personal assistant?
options: It can be tailored to a particular expertise and can act on your behalf, not just respond
It is just Copilot Chat with a new name and no extra capability
It can only answer questions and can never take actions
It cannot be focused on any specific area
questions.explanation: An agent goes beyond responding: it can work alongside you or act on your behalf, and it can be given a specific expertise, such as knowing a company's product catalog.

questions.question: When is a Copilot agent usually a better fit than plain Copilot?
options: When a process is repeatable, has multiple steps, or needs to connect to systems outside Microsoft 365
For quick, one-off requests inside a Microsoft 365 app
Always, because agents are more powerful in every situation
Only for summarizing a single document
questions.explanation: Copilot suits unplanned, one-off tasks inside Microsoft 365 apps, while agents fit repeatable, multi-step processes or ones that connect to outside systems.

questions.question: For predictable, high-volume requests such as IT password resets or HR vacation-policy questions, a prebuilt agent can provide immediate relief.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: When a department faces standardized, repetitive requests like password resets or policy questions, a prebuilt agent is well suited to handle them.

questions.question: Select all valid knowledge sources for a Copilot agent.
options: Trusted public websites
SharePoint content
Copilot connectors that link to external apps and services
Only the user's local hard drive
questions.explanation: Agents can be grounded in trusted web content, SharePoint content, and Copilot connectors to external systems. They are not limited to a local hard drive.

questions.question: Select all the main areas in which a Copilot agent can boost productivity.
options: Retrieving information
Performing actions
Operating independently
Only generating images and slide designs
questions.explanation: Agents help in three main areas: retrieving information, performing actions, and operating independently. Image and slide generation is not their defining purpose.

questions.question: The Employee Self-Service agent provides a single conversational interface for which kinds of tasks?
options: Querying HR policies, opening IT support tickets, and updating personal information
Only HR questions, with no IT capabilities
Only booking meeting rooms
Only questions about public web content
questions.explanation: The Employee Self-Service agent unifies employee requests, letting users query HR policies, start IT support tickets, and update personal information, with separate HR and IT starters.
